title: Monopole settings
description: The settings Monopole's server and actions read when it runs as a Prompting Time plugin, saved in $XDG_STATE_HOME/monopole/settings.json. A blank field keeps the usual source: the environment, the repository's .env, or the adapter's ~/.weave-agent-adapter/evaluations.json. Changes apply when Monopole next starts.

target_registry.title: Target registry
target_registry.description: Path of the JSON registry of the instruction files and skills a proposal may change. The server needs it.

sandbox_runtime.title: Sandbox runtime
sandbox_runtime.description: Path of the JSON runtime for the A/B check's Smol Machines sandbox. The server needs it.

run_db.title: Run database
run_db.description: Path of the SQLite database that holds Monopole's runs. Blank uses WEAVE_AGENT_SIGNALS_RUN_DB, else ~/.weave-agent-signals/runs.db.

port.title: Web UI port
port.description: The port of Monopole's web UI on 127.0.0.1, where new runs start and proposals are reviewed.

ces.title: CES scope
ces.description: Where Monopole reads sessions and writes Scores. Blank fields use the adapter's ~/.weave-agent-adapter/evaluations.json.
